"""Offline synthetic extraction: execute F2 code in a clean detached worktree.

Run with project Python -I -B. This script writes only the explicit output
directory and the generator text there, never the F2 tree. No CLI, ledger replay,
campaign state, network call, process loop, or real market record is used.
"""
import argparse
from collections import Counter
from copy import deepcopy
from dataclasses import asdict
from datetime import date, datetime, timedelta, timezone
from decimal import Decimal as D, getcontext
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import random
import subprocess
import sys
from types import SimpleNamespace

PIN = "c4c3216b1c98f74fd7dc1716c6cf8e45b70beb4f"
SEED = 34701


def sha(data):
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--f2-worktree", required=True, type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--out", required=True, type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--count", type=int, default=1200)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    root, out = args.f2_worktree.resolve(), args.out.resolve()
    assert args.count >= 1000 and not out.is_relative_to(root)
    git = lambda *a: subprocess.check_output(["git", "-C", str(root), *a], text=True).strip()
    assert git("rev-parse", "HEAD") == PIN and not git("status", "--porcelain")
    sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
    sys.path.insert(0, str(root / "src"))
    from weather.market.reward_quote import price_sized_reward_quote, QuoteRefused
    from weather.market.lfc_f2_selection import check_book
    from weather.market.lfc_f2_controller import F2Band
    from weather.market.lfc_capital import CapitalBook, CapitalRefused, native
    from weather.market.lfc_sleeve_loss import sleeve_charge
    from weather.market.lfc_f2_breadth import daily_gate
    from weather.market import lfc_horizon
    from weather.market.mm_stage2_hold import HoldEnd

    rng = random.Random(SEED)
    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    counts, hashes, mixes, unique_counts = {}, {}, {}, {}
    policy = dict(shares_per_leg="20", per_order_cap_pusd="15.80", per_band_cap_pusd="19.60",
                  quote_offset_pusd="0.015", requote_distance_cents=["1", "3"], tokens=["YES", "NO"],
                  min_reward_rate="0", min_book_depth="20", share_many_range=["0", "1"], leg_price_range=["0.17", "0.80"])

    def base_book(bid=D(".40"), ask=D(".43"), size=D(30)):
        level = lambda p: [dict(price=str(p), size=str(size))]
        return dict(yes_bids=level(bid), yes_asks=level(ask), no_bids=level(1-ask), no_asks=level(1-bid),
                    reward_min_size="20", reward_max_spread_cents="4.5", reward_rate_per_day="24",
                    tick="0.01", post_only_available=True)

    def quote(inputs, p):
        try:
            legs = {("YES",): (0,), ("NO",): (1,), ("YES", "NO"): (0, 1)}.get(tuple(p["tokens"]), ())
            q = price_sized_reward_quote(**inputs, size=p["shares_per_leg"],
                per_order_ceiling=p["per_order_cap_pusd"], per_band_ceiling=p["per_band_cap_pusd"],
                quote_offset=p["quote_offset_pusd"], distance_window=p["requote_distance_cents"],
                trade_legs=legs, min_reward_rate=p["min_reward_rate"])
            if any(not D(p["leg_price_range"][0]) <= (q.yes_buy, q.no_buy)[leg] <= D(p["leg_price_range"][1]) for leg in legs):
                raise QuoteRefused("leg_price_outside_range")
            check_book(inputs, mid=q.adjusted_mid, size=q.size, share=q.share_many, policy=SimpleNamespace(raw=p))
            return dict(adjusted_mid=str(q.adjusted_mid), yes_buy=str(q.yes_buy), no_buy=str(q.no_buy), size=str(q.size),
                reserve_pusd=str(q.reserve_pusd), own_q_min=str(q.own_q_min), share_many=q.share_many,
                distances_cents=[str((q.adjusted_mid-q.yes_buy)*100), str((1-q.adjusted_mid-q.no_buy)*100)])
        except QuoteRefused as exc:
            return dict(code=str(exc))

    def write(name, rows):
        hist = Counter()
        path = out / (name + ".jsonl")
        count, unique = 0, set()
        with path.open("w", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n") as target:
            for count, row in enumerate(rows, 1):
                unique.add(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in row.items() if k != "expected"}, sort_keys=True))
                row = dict(id=f"{name}-{count:04d}", **row)
                target.write(json.dumps(row, sort_keys=True, allow_nan=False) + "\n")
                result = row["expected"]
                label = result.get("code") or result.get("decision")
                if label is None:
                    label = ("allowed" if result["allowed"] else "outside_horizon") if "allowed" in result else "admit"
                hist[label] += 1
        counts[path.name], hashes[path.name], mixes[path.name] = count, sha(path.read_bytes()), dict(hist)
        unique_counts[path.name] = len(unique)
        assert len(unique) >= 1000, (name, "insufficient distinct inputs", len(unique))

    def quotes():
        for i in range(args.count):
            p = deepcopy(policy)
            inputs = base_book(size=D(30)+D(i)/10000)
            k = i % 30
            if k == 0: p["quote_offset_pusd"] = ".001"
            elif k == 1: p["shares_per_leg"] = "19"
            elif k == 2: inputs["reward_min_size"] = "21"
            elif k == 3: inputs["reward_max_spread_cents"] = "2.9"
            elif k == 4: inputs["tick"] = ".001"
            elif k == 5: inputs["post_only_available"] = False
            elif k == 6: p["per_order_cap_pusd"] = "16.01"
            elif k == 7: inputs["yes_bids"][0]["price"] = "0"
            elif k == 8: inputs["no_asks"] = []
            elif k == 9: inputs["yes_bids"][0]["price"] = ".401"
            elif k == 10: inputs["yes_bids"][0]["price"] = ".43"
            elif k == 11: inputs = base_book(D(".40"), D(".47"))
            elif k == 12: inputs["yes_bids"][0]["size"] = "19.999999"
            elif k == 13: inputs = base_book(D(".18"), D(".21"))
            elif k == 14: inputs.update(no_bids=[dict(price=".55",size="30")], no_asks=[dict(price=".57",size="30")])
            elif k == 15: p["per_band_cap_pusd"] = "19.30"
            elif k == 16: p["requote_distance_cents"] = ["2", "3"]
            elif k == 17: p["leg_price_range"] = [".41", ".80"]
            elif k == 18: p["share_many_range"] = [".99", "1"]
            elif k == 19: p["min_book_depth"] = "31"
            elif k == 20: inputs["reward_min_size"] = "NaN"
            elif k == 21: inputs["reward_rate_per_day"] = "0"
            elif k == 22: inputs["reward_rate_per_day"] = "40"; p["min_reward_rate"] = "40"
            elif k == 23: inputs["reward_rate_per_day"] = "39.999999"; p["min_reward_rate"] = "40"
            else:
                bid = D(rng.choice([18, 19, 20, 39, 40, 41, 77, 78, 79, 80])) / 100
                inputs = base_book(bid, bid + D(rng.choice([1,2,3,4,5,6])) / 100, D(rng.randint(20, 160)))
                p["quote_offset_pusd"] = rng.choice([".015", ".025"])
            # Preserve every template's decision while making the admissible
            # displayed depth vary in every independently extracted case.
            for side in ("yes_asks", "no_bids", "no_asks"):
                for level in inputs[side]:
                    level["size"] = str(D(level["size"]) + D(i)/10000)
            yield dict(inputs=inputs, policy=p, expected=quote(inputs, p))
    write("quote", quotes())

    def books():
        for i in range(args.count):
            inputs, p = base_book(size=D(30)+D(i)/10000), deepcopy(policy)
            mid, size, share = ".415", "20", "0.5"
            k = i % 14
            if k == 0: inputs["yes_bids"][0]["size"] = "19.999999"
            elif k == 1: inputs["yes_bids"][0]["size"] = "20"
            elif k in (2,3): inputs = base_book(D(".40"), D(".46") if k == 2 else D(".47")); mid = ".43"
            elif k in (4,5): inputs["reward_max_spread_cents"] = "2.9" if k == 4 else "3.0"
            elif k in (6,7): inputs["reward_rate_per_day"] = "0" if k == 6 else ".0001"
            elif k == 8: mid = ".805"
            elif k == 9: p["share_many_range"] = [".6", "1"]
            elif k == 10: inputs["no_bids"][0]["price"] = inputs["no_asks"][0]["price"]
            elif k == 11: inputs["yes_bids"] = []
            elif k == 12: p["min_book_depth"] = "31"
            else: size = str(rng.randint(20, 60))
            inputs["reward_rate_per_day"] = str(D(inputs["reward_rate_per_day"])+D(i)/1_000_000) if k != 6 else "0"
            try:
                check_book(inputs, mid=mid, size=size, share=share, policy=SimpleNamespace(raw=p))
                result = dict(code=None)
            except QuoteRefused as exc:
                result = dict(code=str(exc))
            yield dict(inputs=inputs, policy=p, mid=mid, size=size, share=share, expected=result)
    write("check_book", books())

    def held():
        for i in range(args.count):
            inputs, p = base_book(D(".40"), D(".42"), D(30)+D(i)/10000), deepcopy(policy)
            distance = D([".99", "1", "1.5", "3", "3.01", "4.5"][i % 6])
            prices = (D(".41") - distance/100, D(".59") - distance/100)
            k = i % 13
            if k == 0: inputs["reward_max_spread_cents"] = "3"
            elif k == 1: inputs["reward_min_size"] = "21"
            elif k == 2: inputs["reward_rate_per_day"] = "0"
            elif k == 3: inputs["yes_bids"] = []
            elif k == 4: inputs["yes_bids"][0]["price"] = ".42"
            elif k == 5: p["min_book_depth"] = "31"
            elif k == 6: p["share_many_range"] = [".99", "1"]
            stub = SimpleNamespace(prices=prices, size=D(20), SIZES=(20,30,40,50,75),
                REQUOTE_WINDOW=(D(1),D(3)), TRADE_LEGS=(0,1), MIN_REWARD_RATE=0, campaign_policy=SimpleNamespace(raw=p))
            try:
                result = F2Band.observe_snapshot(stub, dict(quote_inputs=inputs))
                decision = "requote" if result["requote_legs"] else "hold"
            except (HoldEnd, QuoteRefused):
                decision = "retire"
            yield dict(inputs=inputs, policy=p, prices=list(map(str,prices)), expected=dict(decision=decision))
    write("observe_held", held())

    def sleeves():
        for i in range(args.count):
            loss, costs = D(rng.randint(0,80)), D(rng.randint(0,9))
            gains = (D(0), (loss+costs)/2, loss+costs+10)[i%3]
            row = dict(loss=loss, inventory=D(rng.randint(0,200))+D(i)/1_000_000, resting=D(rng.randint(0,200)), costs=costs,
                       available_gains=gains, basis=("gross", "net_of_retained_gains")[i%2])
            charged, offset = sleeve_charge(**row)
            yield dict(inputs={k:str(v) for k,v in row.items()}, expected=dict(charged=str(charged), offset=str(offset)))
    write("sleeve_charge", sleeves())

    def gates():
        for i in range(args.count):
            c = dict(funding="300", inventory="100", resting="150", losses="40", costs="0", available_gains="10",
                     profit="10", incentives="0", external="0", basis="net_of_retained_gains")
            reserve, own, cash = "19.60", "0", "500"
            k = i%12
            if k == 0: reserve = "20"
            elif k == 1: reserve = "20.000001"
            elif k == 2: own = "150.000001"
            elif k == 3: cash = "169.60"
            elif k == 4: cash = "169.599999"
            elif k == 5: reserve = "19.6000001"
            elif k == 6: own = ".0000001"
            elif k == 7: c["basis"] = "gross"
            elif k == 8: c.update(available_gains="50", profit="50"); reserve="50"
            elif k == 9: c.update(available_gains="0", profit="0", incentives="50")
            else:
                c.update(inventory=str(rng.randint(0,250)), resting=str(rng.randint(0,150)),
                    losses=str(rng.randint(0,80)), costs=str(rng.randint(0,9)), available_gains=str(rng.randint(0,25)))
                c["profit"] = str(D(c["available_gains"])+D(rng.randint(0,10)))
                c["basis"] = rng.choice(["gross", "net_of_retained_gains"])
                cash, reserve = str(rng.randint(0,400)), str(D(rng.randint(0,40_000_000))/1_000_000)
                if k == 10:
                    own = str(D(c["resting"])/2)
            c["incentives"] = str(D(c["incentives"])+D(i)/1_000_000)
            if k in (3,4):
                cash = str(D(cash)+D(i)/1_000_000)
            charged, offset = sleeve_charge(loss=native(c["losses"]), inventory=native(c["inventory"]),
                resting=native(c["resting"]), costs=native(c["costs"]), available_gains=native(c["available_gains"]), basis=c["basis"])
            figures = dict(funding_native=native(c["funding"]), charged_native=charged,
                resting_reserve_native=native(c["resting"]), retained_gains_offset_native=offset)
            stub = SimpleNamespace(bridge={}, ledger=SimpleNamespace(halted=False,mismatches=[]), unknown=[], activities={},
                figures=lambda **kw:dict(figures), profit=native(c["profit"]), incentives=native(c["incentives"]), external=0,
                expected_cash=lambda:native(cash), quarantined_after_bridge=lambda:0,
                cash_before_bridge=lambda activity:False, blocking_unknown=lambda:[])
            try:
                actual = CapitalBook.gate(stub, reserve=reserve, own_resting=own, available_cash=cash, loss_basis=c["basis"])
                result = dict(ok=True, code=None, figures={k:str(v) for k,v in actual.items()})
            except CapitalRefused as exc:
                result = dict(ok=False, code=str(exc), figures={})
            yield dict(capital=c, reserve=reserve, own_resting=own,
                       cash=dict(available=cash,expected=cash,quarantined_after_bridge="0"), expected=result)
    write("gate", gates())

    def days():
        for i in range(args.count):
            filled, resting, reserve, own, cap = D(25), D("9.60"), "5.40", "0", "40"
            k=i%8
            if k==1: reserve="5.400001"
            elif k==2: own="9.600001"
            elif k==3: reserve="5.4000001"
            elif k==4: own=".0000001"
            elif k==5: cap="40.0000001"
            else:
                filled,resting=D(rng.randint(0,40)), D(rng.randint(0,20))
            delta=D(i+1)/1_000_000
            if resting >= delta:
                filled,resting=filled+delta,resting-delta
            elif filled >= delta:
                filled,resting=filled-delta,resting+delta
            else:
                reserve=str(D(reserve)+delta)
            legs = [(dict(status="terminal",price=".5",size=str(filled*2),size_matched=str(filled*2)), i%3==0),
                    (dict(status="resting",price=".5",size=str(resting*2),size_matched="0"), False)]
            ledger = SimpleNamespace(band_day_legs=lambda market,day:legs)
            start = dict(protocol="lfc_autostart_v3",market_id="nyc",quote_day_utc="2026-09-20",
                         recorded_at_utc="2026-09-20T12:00:00+00:00",per_band_daily_filled_cap_pusd=cap)
            try:
                result = daily_gate(ledger,start,reserve=reserve,own_resting=own)
                expected=dict(ok=True,code=None,figures={k:str(v) for k,v in result.items()})
            except CapitalRefused as exc:
                expected=dict(ok=False,code=str(exc),figures={})
            yield dict(usage=dict(filled=str(filled),resting=str(resting),unmapped_legacy=str(filled if i%3==0 else 0)),
                       reserve=reserve,own_resting=own,cap=cap,expected=expected)
    write("daily_gate", days())

    def horizons():
        zones = ["Pacific/Auckland","America/Toronto","America/New_York","America/Chicago","America/Denver",
            "America/Los_Angeles","Europe/London","Europe/Paris","Europe/Helsinki","Asia/Karachi","Asia/Kolkata","Asia/Tokyo"]
        # Registry injection is entirely synthetic and in memory. No fixture
        # can use a misbound live identity; only the unchanged F2 DTE code runs.
        lfc_horizon.REGISTRY = {f"synthetic-{i}":SimpleNamespace(timezone=z) for i,z in enumerate(zones)}
        for i in range(args.count):
            z = i%12
            now=datetime(2026,11,1,tzinfo=timezone.utc)+timedelta(minutes=(i//12)*31)
            from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
            target=now.astimezone(ZoneInfo(zones[z])).date()+timedelta(days=(i//12)%3)
            row=dict(market_id=f"synthetic-{z}",market_timezone=zones[z],target_date=target.isoformat())
            result=lfc_horizon.horizon_allowed(row,now,allowed=(1,))
            yield dict(city=row["market_id"],zone=zones[z],target=target.isoformat(),now=now.isoformat(),expected=dict(allowed=result))
    write("horizon", horizons())
    sources = ["reward_quote.py","lfc_f2_selection.py","mm_stage2_hold.py","lfc_capital.py","lfc_sleeve_loss.py",
               "lfc_f2_breadth.py","lfc_horizon.py","lfc_accounting.py","re1_attended.py","lfc_f2_controller.py","reward_share_estimate.py"]
    source_shas={name:sha((root/"src/weather/market"/name).read_bytes()) for name in sources}
    diff = git("diff","--stat","ef3882d2",PIN,"--",*["src/weather/market/"+name for name in sources])
    assert not git("status", "--porcelain"), "F2 tree was mutated"
    text=Path(__file__).read_bytes()
    (out/"extract_f2_parity.py.txt").write_bytes(text)
    universe_sha = git("rev-parse", "190783d34")
    universe_bytes = subprocess.check_output(["git", "-C", str(root), "show", universe_sha+":config/weather_universe.json"])
    assert (out.parent/"weather_universe_t046.json").read_bytes() == universe_bytes
    provenance=dict(f2_git_sha=PIN,f2_worktree_clean=True,generator_sha256=sha(text),python_version=sys.version,
        decimal_context=str(getcontext()), generated_utc=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),case_counts=counts,
        fixture_sha256=hashes,case_mix=mixes,unique_input_counts=unique_counts,seed=SEED,source_sha256=source_shas,source_diff_from_ef3882d2=diff,
        parity_domain="reconciled clean simulation states only; expected cash equals available; no quarantine or unknown/external activity",
        gains_domain="proved retained redemption gains only; reward/rebate accrual excluded from G",
        horizon_registry="synthetic in-memory identity map across twelve zones; unchanged F2 horizon functions",
        universe_fixture=dict(t046_git_sha=universe_sha,source_path="config/weather_universe.json",
                              fixture="../weather_universe_t046.json",sha256=sha(universe_bytes)),
        command="project-python.exe -I -B extract_f2_parity.py --f2-worktree <clean-pin> --out <fixtures> --count "+str(args.count))
    (out/"PROVENANCE.json").write_text(json.dumps(provenance,indent=2)+"\n",encoding="utf-8",newline="\n")
    print(json.dumps(dict(case_counts=counts,case_mix=mixes),indent=2))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
